title: (feat) Migrate stock management to workspace v2
body:
## Requirements

- [x] This PR has a title that briefly describes the work done including the ticket number. If there is a ticket, make sure your PR title includes a [conventional commit](https://o3-docs.openmrs.org/en-US/docs/frontend-modules/contributing/#contributing-guidelines) label. See existing PR titles for inspiration.
- [ ] My work is based on designs, which are linked or shown either in the Jira ticket or the description below. (See also: [Styleguide](http://om.rs/o3ui))
- [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests.

## Summary
Migrates the stock management workspaces from the v1 workspace API to workspace v2, ahead of [openmrs-esm-core#1893](https://github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-core/pull/1893), which removes the v1 API from the framework.

- `routes.json` declares a `stock-management-group` overlay group with one window per workspace. The windows keep the extra-wide width and maximize button the v1 workspaces had. The group uses the default app-wide persistence, because a closable group hides the header close button on desktop and expects the action menu to provide it, and this app has no action menu.
- Each workspace takes `Workspace2DefinitionProps`, reads its props from `workspaceProps`, and renders inside `Workspace2`. The titles callers used to pass as `workspaceTitle` are now set by the workspaces, using the same translation keys, so `en.json` doesn't change.
- Launch sites use `launchWorkspace2`. The two launch helpers no longer take `t`.
- The stock rule form is now a child workspace of the stock item workspace. It used to replace the stock item form. Now cancelling or saving it returns you to the stock item, still on the Rules tab.
- After a new stock item is saved, the form relaunches the stock item workspace with the saved item instead of closing and reopening it. The two v2 calls are async and could race.
- Removes the `stock-location-form-workspace` adapter. It only opened the create location modal, which the locations table already opens directly, and nothing launches it.
- Adds a `mockWorkspace2Props` helper to `__mocks__` for rendering workspaces in tests.

The diff is mostly re-indentation from wrapping each form in `Workspace2`. It's easier to review with whitespace hidden.

Some existing issues I noticed that behave the same on main:
- The items list doesn't refresh after creating or editing an item.
- The stock rule form has almost no horizontal padding.

## Summary
Removes the `.cds--table-sort__description { display: none; }` rule in `table.scss`. This selector lacks `:global()` and has no module-scoped ancestor, so CSS Modules rewrites the class name and it never matches Carbon's markup — the rule has never had any effect. This is a behavior-preserving dead code removal.

Verified via:
- Grep confirms no `cds--` class names remain in the file
- Production build passes, including the selector guard added in openmrs/openmrs-esm-core#1869
- Existing test and lint suites pass unchanged

Not applicable — no visual or behavioral change, since the removed rule was already inert.

No new tests added intentionally: the deleted rule had no effect, so there is no new behavior to cover. A clean production build is the verification that no rendering depended on it, including confirmation that no Carbon-only-anchored selector was reintroduced (per the esm-core#1869 build guard).

The compressed-size action builds the pull request and base revisions sequentially in the same workspace. ## Summary

Stock report submission was broken end-to-end:

- The `<Form>` had no `onSubmit` handler, so clicking Save did nothing.
- `handleSave` read `report.reportSystemName`, which is not on the form schema, causing every report parameter dependent on the system name to resolve to `undefined` and the backend to receive null parameters.
- The Patient and Stock Item inputs were never rendered, so report types requiring them could not be submitted.
- The `location` field was required at the schema level even for report types that do not use it, blocking submission with a "Location Required" error on a hidden field.

This PR:
- Wires `handleSubmit(handleSave)` to the form's `onSubmit`.
- Looks up `reportSystemName` from `reportTypes` and threads it through the parameter builders.
- Makes `location` optional in the schema and adds a parameter-aware required check inside `handleSave`.
- Adds debounced Patient and Stock Item ComboBoxes backed by `/patient` and `/stockmanagement/stockitem`.
- Reduces `useGetReports` polling from 1s to 15s (refresh) / 10s (dedupe) and falls back to `totalCount` for pagination.

- [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests.

## Summary

Selecting a different stock item while the edit panel was open updated the workspace title but left the form fields showing the previously selected item's values.

Root cause: `StockItemDetails` initializes its form via `useForm({ defaultValues: stockItem ?? {} })`. React Hook Form only reads `defaultValues` on initial mount, so subsequent changes to the `stockItem` prop do not flow into the form fields.

Fix: add `key={stockItem?.uuid}` to `<StockItemDetails>` in `AddEditStockItem`. When the stock item changes, the key changes, React unmounts and remounts the component, and `useForm` re-initializes from the new `defaultValues`.

The other tabs in the same workspace (`PackagingUnits`, `Transactions`, etc.) do not have this pattern, since they either use SWR keyed on `stockItemUuid` or sync local state via a `useEffect`. So the fix is scoped to the one component that needs it.
